conviction_note: DMG MORI AG has been under a domination and profit-and-loss transfer agreement (DPLTA) with DMG MORI Europe Holding since 2016. Its profit goes to the parent, and outside shareholders receive a fixed recurring compensation (Ausgleich) of EUR 1.28 gross a share, made final by OLG Duesseldorf on 2026-10-01. The share therefore trades like a bond: 20-day realised volatility is 0.27% a session, and on its last four results days it closed -0.64%, 0.0%, +0.6% and +0.64%. The Q3 statement cannot change what a minority holder is paid, so abs_move is 0.5 and p_up is 50 (no view). The one directional item, how far the raised FY EBIT guide relies on H2, is an inference and is sized near zero. Note that the EUR 0.10 tick (0.21%) makes an unchanged close likely, which p_up=50 does not represent.

already_public.what: H1 2026 results and the raised FY2026 guide: order intake EUR 2.4-2.6bn (was 2.3-2.5), sales EUR 2.1-2.3bn (was 2.0-2.2), EBIT EUR 100-120m (was 90-110), FCF EUR 90-110m (was 80-100). H1 EBIT was EUR 31.5m (prior year 44.9) and H1 order intake EUR 1,363.5m (+19%). The stock moved 47.2 -> 47.5 on the day.

Ad-hoc: OLG Duesseldorf (order of 25.09.2026, I-26 W 2/23 [AktE]) dismissed the appeals in the DPLTA appraisal proceedings. The cash exit compensation stays at EUR 37.35, below the EUR 47.2 spot. The recurring compensation rises from EUR 1.17 to EUR 1.28 gross (EUR 1.11 net) 'as already decided at first instance' (LG Dortmund, 2023), so the increase was public since 2023. Released 17:22 CEST; the stock did not react (46.9 -> 46.8 -> 46.7).

findings.finding: Under the DPLTA, DMG MORI AG's results go to DMG MORI Europe Holding, and outside shareholders receive a fixed annual Ausgleich of EUR 1.28 gross (EUR 1.11 net), confirmed final on 2026-10-01. The Q3 numbers therefore cannot change what a minority share is paid, which is why the stock's results-day moves are about 0.6% and it did not react to the August guidance raise.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. That is the point: the 0.27% daily realised volatility and the flat reactions to every print this year are the market already treating results as irrelevant. This finding sets the scale (abs_move) and is not a directional edge.
findings.independence: Yahoo daily tape (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GIL.DE?range=1y&interval=1d): close-to-close moves on results days were under 0.7%.

findings.finding: The raised FY2026 EBIT guide of EUR 100-120m requires EUR 68.5-88.5m in H2 against EUR 31.5m in H1 (Q2 EBIT EUR 16.2m, Q3 2025 EBIT EUR 16.3m). If Q3 comes in near the Q2 run-rate, the guide may be steered to the low end. This is inference from company numbers, and the Q4 seasonality it rests on is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guidance raise on 2026-08-04 moved the stock +0.64%. The slight 2024 Q3 guide trim (press release of 4 Nov 2024) has no measured reaction here.
findings.why_not_priced: Arguably irrelevant rather than unpriced: under the DPLTA, profit belongs to the parent. If it were priced as for a normal stock, the August raise would have moved the shares by several percent; it moved 0.64%.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 statement for the seasonality base (https://de.dmgmori-ag.com/resource/blob/932540/02e5e4fe54d39a63327ef02bbb0fbf0e/dmgmori325d-data.pdf, 'EBIT 16,3 ... Vorjahr 43,4'). VDW industry orders +12% in Q2 2026 (https://www.produktion.de/tag/vdw) point the other way, toward strong orders.

outside_window.finding: Back-payment of the EUR 0.11 gross per share per year Ausgleich increase for the affected financial years, which DMG MORI Europe Holding says it will pay. No payment date is given, it was public since 2026-10-01, and it did not move the stock.

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'the move is in the guide': abs_move_pct went from 0.4 to 0.5, because a guide change on this print is possible. I did not go higher, because the name's own observed results-day moves (all 0.64% or less) reflect the DPLTA contract rather than small-sample noise. This is the same logic as the lesson 'in a live bid, results are noise'.
